title: A large binary Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $f:(\\mathbb{F}_2)^n\\to\\mathbb{R}$ satisfy $|f(x)|=1$ for every $x$. Then some binary Fourier coefficient of $f$ has square at least $2^{-n}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the binary cube
